questions.question: What reform did Asa carry out in Judah?
options: Built many new idols throughout the whole of the land
Removed foreign altars, high places, pillars, and Asherim
Stopped all worship at the temple of the LORD in Jerusalem
Made a binding alliance with the king of Egypt
questions.answer: Removed foreign altars, high places, pillars, and Asherim

questions.question: Whom did Asa defeat when a vast army came against Judah?
options: Ben-hadad, the mighty king of Aram
